Digitorium is a digital agency in Ahmedabad. We build websites and custom software, run Meta and Google ads, shoot the photos and video, and handle the SEO and branding around all of it.
Clients in India, Canada, the Congo and elsewhere
Digitorium started with one website and one problem: a business that was spending on ads and getting nothing back. The ads were fine. The page they landed on was not.

That has been the pattern ever since. Most of what we get asked to fix is not the thing the client thinks is broken. A makeup studio that needed a website turned out to need a booking flow on WhatsApp. A fabric shop that wanted better billing needed the tailoring pipeline tracked as well. A freight company that asked for a website ended up with a portal that makes bills of lading on a phone.
So we stopped selling packages. We look at what exists, find the leak, and quote for fixing that. Sometimes the answer is a full rebuild. Often it is smaller and cheaper than what was expected.
Five years in, that has meant around a hundred projects across ten countries, from Gota to the Congo.
Seven of them are written up as case studies, with the numbers included.
None of these are clever. They are just uncommon enough to be worth writing down.
You will not be passed to an account manager who then relays your brief to someone else. The person on the call is the person doing the work, which is why the work matches the brief.

Small, on purpose. It means you always speak to the person doing the work, and it means we take on fewer clients at a time. If a project needs more hands than we have, we will tell you at the quote stage instead of after.
Do you work with clients outside Ahmedabad?
Yes. Around a third of the work is for clients abroad, including Canada and the Congo. Most of it runs over calls and WhatsApp. Shoots need us on location.
It depends on scope. We quote in writing after one call, with the work listed line by line. There are no packages, because the packages never match what a business actually needs.
Can you take over work another agency started?
Often, yes. Send us the link or the account. If the build is too tangled to be worth repairing we will say so rather than bill you to patch it.
Who owns the website and the ad account?
You do. Hosting, domain, ad account and analytics stay in your name. If you ever leave, everything is already yours.
